content:
maria: FYI got a support ticket — customer says they hit quota throttles even though usage dashboard shows headroom. Repro on staging too.

sam: Which quota? per-org or per-key?

maria: per-org burst quota. They sent a batch of requests at 11:06 UTC and got 429s for ~3m. Dashboard (console -> Quotas -> org/12345) shows usage ramping but not enough to justify enforcement.

jing: Maybe metering pipeline lag. The enforcement service reads from Redis counters updated by the real-time ingest API, while billing uses the events after kafka->lake. If redis updates lost or delayed we can enforce incorrectly.

maria: Here's enforcement log from the pod around 11:06:

```
[11:06:09] enforce.go:checkQuota org=12345 key=api_abc current=980 burst_limit=1000 allowed=false
[11:06:09] throttle.go:emitThrottle org=12345 reason=burst-window
```

Dashboard snapshot link: https://console.redwood.internal/quotas/org/12345?view=timeline (private)

tony: I see a gap in the realtime-ingest consumer errors at 11:05 — consumer lag jumped from 0 to 12k ms for ~2m in our telemetry. Could be GC pause on the ingest service.

elena: ops-bot reported a transient kafka partition rebalance at 11:04 too. That may have delayed the connector writing to Redis.

ops-bot: incident-notify: kafka/ingest-connector partition 4 rebalance at 2025-05-03T11:04:50Z (auto-recover).

sam: Two problems: 1) enforcement reads the short-lived redis counters; 2) Redis counter updates are not idempotent with retries so if the ingest fails we don't get the delta. Need reconciliation.

maria: Agreed. Short term: can we add a shadow-enforcement read that compares enforcement counter vs last-known metering snapshot and logs mismatches (no action, only telemetry)? Want to be able to alert before customer impact.

jing: Yeah. Also we should change enforcement to tolerate small negative deltas: if enforcement counter > metered_total + threshold => allow for N seconds and emit warning. Implement as a soft-fail window.

tony: For a quick fix: turn on read-through to the billing-aggregates service for bursts. If enforcement sees a counter near threshold and redis shows low values, fetch aggregates as fallback. Adds <20ms for rare paths.

elena: We'll need a config flag per-cluster. We should rollout as a canary to 20% of traffic.

sam: Long term: fix the ingest pipeline durability. Add at-least-once semantics on connector writes, ensure retries backoff, and add an idempotent increment pattern: `INCRBY key delta IF seq==expected` or use vector of events.

maria: Also need a reconciliation job: hourly job that compares enforcement counters (redis) vs billing aggregates (kafka->lake) and backfills or flags diffs > 0.5%. Create an alert on > 5% mismatch for any org.

jing: I'll sketch the reconciliation job: scan orgs, sample last 1h, compute (enforcement_counter - metered_events) / max(1,metered_events). Emit metrics `quota.mismatch.pct`. Post to #eng-platform when any org >5%.

tony: Can we add a console widget for "enforcement health" showing latest mismatch pct per org and last reconciliation run time? Product likes visualizing this so support can triage.

maria: Yes, product asked for that yesterday. Add a link in quota details: "Enforcement health" panel.

elena: I'll own the canary rollout for the fallback read-through and the new console widget wiring.

sam: I'll own the enforcement change (soft-fail window) and the shadow mismatch logger. Jing will do the reconciliation job. Maria will coordinate with support and product.

maria: Plan: patch release for enforcement soft-fail + shadow logger this week (canary 20%); reconciliation job + alert next week; ingest connector fix (durability) as infra epic Q3.

elena: One more ask: update the SLAs doc to note that enforcement is based on realtime counters and subject to transient mismatches; include link to reconciliation dashboard.

maria: Noted. I'll PR the SLA note.

sam: quick diagnostic command people can run against prod: `redis-cli --raw HGET quota:org:12345 burst_current` and `curl -s https://billing-api.internal/orgs/12345/usage?window=5m | jq .tokens`

jing: Also if you see a mismatch run `kafka-consumer-lag --group ingest-connector --topic quotas-events` and check `ingest-connector` logs for errors.

maria: Thanks team. I'll close the ticket after we deploy the canary and run the reconciliation once.

elena: Will post deployment times in #eng-releases. :thumbsup:
